name: io.github.doradx/annas-archive-mcp
title: Anna's Archive MCP
description: Search Anna's Archive metadata, look up files by MD5 or DOI, and download authorized files through MCP.

environmentVariables.name: ANNAS_BASE_URLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Anna's Archive mirror URLs. Optional; defaults are built in.

environmentVariables.name: ANNAS_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Anna's Archive fast download API key. Required only for anna_download.

environmentVariables.name: ANNAS_MAX_DOWNLOAD_MB
environmentVariables.description: Global maximum download size in megabytes. Default: 250.
